sentences.text: Joseph James Rogan -LRB- born August 11 , 1967 -RRB- is an American stand-up comedian , color commentator , television host , actor , podcast host , and retired martial artist .	color commentator	color commentator

He developed an interest in martial arts as a teenager and learned karate , kickboxing , and taekwondo , in which he became a black belt and a four-time state champion and a U.S. Open champion .	black belt	black belt (martial arts)

He is black belt in no-gi Brazilian jiu-jitsu under Eddie Bravo and gi black belt under Jean Jacques Machado .	black belt	black belt (martial arts)	Brazilian jiu-jitsu	Brazilian jiu-jitsu	Eddie Bravo	Eddie Bravo	Jean Jacques Machado	Jean Jacques Machado
A fan of comedy since his youth , Rogan began a career in stand-up in August 1988 in the Boston area , developing a blue comedy act .	blue comedy	blue comedy	Boston	Boston
He moved to New York City two years later .

After relocating to Los Angeles in 1994 , Rogan signed an exclusive developmental deal with Disney , appeared as an actor on the television sitcoms Hardball and NewsRadio , and worked in local comedy clubs .	Disney	Disney	Hardball	Hardball (1994 TV series)	NewsRadio	NewsRadio

In 1997 , he started working for the Ultimate Fighting Championship -LRB- UFC -RRB- as an interviewer and color commentator since 2002 .	color commentator	color commentator	Ultimate Fighting Championship	Ultimate Fighting Championship
Rogan released his first comedy special in 2000 , and has since produced seven other specials .

From 2001 , he has been the host of several television shows , including Fear Factor , The Man Show , and Joe Rogan Questions Everything .	Fear Factor	Fear Factor	The Man Show	The Man Show	Joe Rogan Questions Everything	Joe Rogan Questions Everything

In 2009 , Rogan launched his podcast The Joe Rogan Experience which has become one of the most popular podcasts available ; in October 2015 , it was downloaded 16 million times a month .	The Joe Rogan Experience	The Joe Rogan Experience
Rogan is also an advocate of the legalization of cannabis , hunting , and overall physical and mental well-being .	legalization of cannabis	legalization of cannabis
